$Comment: Defense XP added to what one cleared wave of the restless dead banks in the restless graveyard (the
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Wave table), on a server running MMO Skill Tree.
ContributesTo folds this roll into that table without touching its file, so the table's own pay
is tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, so the
table pays exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1. A roll with no
Chance always pays, and Amount is XP before any boost. The run rolls the table once per cleared wave,
so keep Amount small: ten waves pay it ten times. The dungeon pays the first run each day in full and
later ones half, and that halving reaches this roll too.
Name: Mmo_Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Wave
